dbms.name: ER Model & Relational Algebra
dbms.description: Entity-Relationship schemas, candidate keys, selection, projection, join operations.

dbms.name: Normalization & Functional Dependencies
dbms.description: 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, closure of attributes, lossless decomposition, dependency preservation.

dbms.name: Transactions & Concurrency Control
dbms.description: ACID properties, serializability (conflict and view), 2-phase locking (2PL), deadlock recovery.

dbms.name: SQL & Indexing (B/B+ Trees)
dbms.description: SQL nested queries, aggregates, group by, dense and sparse indexing, B-Trees and B+ Trees.

os.name: Process & CPU Scheduling
os.description: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin, Priority scheduling, turnaround & waiting time calculations.

os.name: Synchronization & Deadlocks
os.description: Critical section problem, Peterson's algorithm, semaphores, Banker's algorithm, resource graph.

os.name: Memory Management & Virtual Memory
os.description: Contiguous allocation, paging, segmentation, TLB hit ratios, page replacement (FIFO, LRU, Optimal).

os.name: Disk Scheduling & File Systems
os.description: SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, SSTF disk arm scheduling, inode structure, and allocation methods.

cn.name: OSI Layers & Data Link Layer
cn.description: Framing, CRC error detection, Flow Control (Stop & Wait, Go-Back-N, Selective Repeat), CSMA/CD.

cn.name: Network Layer & IPv4 Subnetting
cn.description: CIDR, classless IP addressing, subnet masking, supernetting, fragmentation, Distance Vector & Link State.

cn.name: Transport Layer (TCP / UDP)
cn.description: TCP 3-way handshake, connection termination, flow control (sliding window), TCP congestion control (AIMD).

cn.name: Application Layer & Security
cn.description: DNS resolution, HTTP, SMTP, FTP, RSA public key cryptography, symmetric key basics.

dsa.name: Linear Data Structures
dsa.description: Arrays, Singly & Doubly Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Circular Queues, Infix/Postfix conversions.

dsa.name: Trees & Priority Queues
dsa.description: Binary Trees, BST, AVL Trees, Red-Black Trees, Binary Heaps, Heapify operations, Priority Queues.

dsa.name: Graph Algorithms
dsa.description: BFS, DFS, Dijkstra's algorithm, Bellman-Ford, Prim's & Kruskal's MST, Topological Sorting.

dsa.name: Sorting & Searching Techniques
dsa.description: Binary search, Merge Sort, Quick Sort, Counting Sort, Radix Sort, Lower bounds on comparison sorts.

toc.name: Regular Expressions & Finite Automata
toc.description: DFA construction, NFA to DFA conversion, minimization of DFA, Pumping Lemma for Regular Languages.

toc.name: Context-Free Grammars & PDA
toc.description: Ambiguity in CFG, Chomsky Normal Form, Deterministic and Non-deterministic Pushdown Automata.

coa.name: Instruction Pipelining & Hazards
coa.description: Structural hazards, data hazards (RAW, WAR, WAW), control hazards, branch prediction, speedup factor.

coa.name: Cache Memory Organization
coa.description: Direct mapped, fully associative, set-associative cache, hit latency, write-through vs write-back.
